_note: Supplementary LLM candidates = close variants of the proven gate-passing mechanisms, to top up to 20.

factors.name: mispr_fin_disc_op
factors.rationale: Mispricing reversal with financing and investment discipline, reinforced by operating profitability.

factors.name: mispr_sale_growth_disc
factors.rationale: Mispricing combined with low issuance and restrained sales growth (revenue-side overexpansion).

factors.name: cashprof_taccruals_disc
factors.rationale: Cash profitability with low total accruals and disciplined issuance = high-quality real earnings.

factors.name: ev_value_ebit_disc
factors.rationale: Enterprise-multiple value with gross profitability, financing and investment discipline.

factors.name: sale_bev_cashprof_disc
factors.rationale: Sales to book-enterprise-value with cash profitability and low asset growth.

factors.name: issuance_resff_reversal
factors.rationale: Financing discipline with FF3-residual momentum, guarded against short-term reversal.

factors.name: financing_disc_prof_value
factors.rationale: Broad equity+debt financing discipline with cash profitability and value.

factors.name: mispr_perf_accrual_quality
factors.rationale: Performance mispricing cluster with low accruals, low issuance, and profitability support.

factors.name: opasset_growth_cashprof
factors.rationale: Growth in current and non-current operating assets are overinvestment signals; cash profitability offsets them.

factors.name: mispr_noa_quality
factors.rationale: Mispricing with low bloat and investment discipline, supported by operating profitability.
